shellCommands.command: ls -la app lib && cat app/* lib/* next.config.ts tsconfig.json

cat node_modules/next/package.json | grep '"version"'; echo "---cache exports---"; cat node_modules/next/cache.js 2>/dev/null | head -50; echo "---cache.d.ts---"; cat node_modules/next/cache.d.ts 2>/dev/null

grep -rl "cacheComponents" node_modules/next/dist/server/config-schema.js node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.d.ts 2>/dev/null; echo "=== cacheComponents refs ==="; grep -o "cacheComponents[?:]*[^;]*" node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.d.ts | head; echo "=== useCache refs ==="; grep -o "useCache[?:]*[^;]*" node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.d.ts | head

grep -n "cacheComponents" node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.d.ts | head; echo "=== context ==="; grep -n -B2 -A4 "^    cacheComponents?: boolean" node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.d.ts
